C0614.title: Man in His 20s Sentenced for 4.7 Million Yuan Alipay Huabei Cash-Out Scheme
C0614.summary: A man in his 20s was sentenced to 2 years and 6 months in prison for using Alipay's Huabei service to conduct cash-out transactions totaling 4.7 million yuan, highlighting the criminal liability for fraudulent cash-outs via consumer credit products.

references.title: Post-90s Man Cashes Out 4.7 Million Yuan via 'Huabei', Sentenced to 2 Years and 6 Months, Netizens: I've Done It Too...
